notes: Chat uses Cohere's documented OpenAI-compatibility surface (base https://api.cohere.ai/compatibility/v1), so the OpenAI Chat dialect is correct there; rerank uses Cohere's own v1 endpoint. Model ids differ per surface (command-* for chat, rerank-* for rerank), so register each with POST /api/models/custom. Cohere publishes no model-list endpoint for the compatibility surface, so model discovery is expected to fail for this provider.
